B-StoryCards

Story Planning Cards

Status
In use (updates as needed)

A simple tool for organising ideas, structuring narratives, and planning story sequences using cards. It allows users to create cards containing actions, notes, visual ideas, and dialogue, then organise them into columns and arrange them into a narrative sequence.

Data can be imported and exported in CSV format, making it easy to create backups and share information between users or devices.

Try it here. The source code is available in the GitHub repository.
